name: application-tiered-donation-buttons
title: Tiered Donation Buttons
description: Preset donation-amount buttons paired with a real-world impact label per tier and a custom-amount field, distinct from application-variant-selector since each option carries a price and impact description rather than a product variant.
useWhen: Letting a donor pick a preset amount with a concrete description of what it funds.
Offering a custom-amount field alongside preset tiers for donors who want to give a different amount.
Supporting both monthly and one-time giving with different tier sets per frequency.
avoidWhen: The options represent a product variant (size, color) rather than a donation amount — use application-variant-selector instead.
No real impact data is available — omit the impact label rather than fabricating what an amount funds.
Only a single fixed donation amount is accepted — a plain button is simpler than a tier selector.
responsiveBehavior: Variant 1's three-column tier grid collapses to fewer columns on very narrow screens if wrapped in a responsive grid class; Variant 2's stacked rows already fit narrow widths without changes.
accessibility: Each tier group carries role='radiogroup' with role='radio' and aria-checked per option, since only one amount can be selected at a time.
The selected tier is distinguished by a border, background tint, and aria-checked together, not color alone.
The custom-amount field carries a real label and an inputMode of 'numeric' to bring up the right keyboard on mobile.

variants.title: Grid with custom amount
variants.description: Three-column preset amount grid with an impact label per tier and a custom-amount field beneath.
accessibility: The donate button's label states the exact amount that will be charged, not just 'Donate'.

variants.title: Grid with custom amount (Dark)
variants.description: Preset amount grid with a custom-amount field, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected tier border and background contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Card with frequency toggle
variants.description: Donation card with a monthly/one-time frequency toggle and stacked tier rows, each with a full-width impact description.
accessibility: The frequency toggle is a real radiogroup, not a visual-only pill, so its state is announced to assistive technology.

variants.title: Card with frequency toggle (Dark)
variants.description: Donation card with a frequency toggle, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Frequency toggle and tier row contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
